summary: Celularity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement Agreement with Helena Global Investment Opportunities 1 Ltd., resolving claims from a prior convertible preferred exchange and note default. Terms include an immediate $500,000 payment plus five monthly $100,000 payments and assignment of rights under a $2.5M note, in exchange for surrender of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock and release of claims. No price per share, premium, or vote is specified; the agreement restructures obligations under existing transaction documents. The filing lacks a board recommendation or advisor. For risk-arb, focus on Celularity's liquidity to meet payment schedule and subsequent financing needs.
